parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module's services use two different persistence abstractions. ReceivingService reaches storage only through the table classes (ItemTable, BinTable) and turns records into the domain objects Bin and Item. CycleCountService injects PrismaService and calls the ORM directly (stockCount.create, stockCount.findMany), so it bypasses the module's table/repository approach and skips the domain model entirely. Both candidate flags are confirmed by the source. CycleCountService also writes the discrepancy rule twice: count() and openDiscrepancies() each spell out `counted !== expected` and `delta = counted - expected` instead of calling one shared definition.
